title: Locker Rental: inspection frequency, abandoned property hold and disposal terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, how often staff inspect lockers presumed unclaimed, the number of days property left in a closed locker is held, and the number of days after closure at which unclaimed property may be disposed of. The rule governing when property may actually be disposed of, and how the hold and disposal periods are counted from closure, is a separate handling matter and is not restated here.

## Inspection and abandoned-property table
| Tier | Inspection frequency | Property hold period | Disposal eligible after |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | Every 30 days | 14 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Medium Locker | Every 30 days | 14 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Large Locker | Every 45 days | 14 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | Every 60 days | 21 calendar days | 45 calendar days |
| Day-Use Locker | Every 1 day | 1 calendar day | 7 calendar days |
| VIP Locker Suite | Every 90 days | 30 calendar days | 60 calendar days |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- How often are lockers presumed unclaimed inspected in the VIP Locker Suite tier? Every ninety days.
- After how many calendar days from closure may unclaimed property in a Premium Climate-Controlled Locker be disposed of? Forty-five calendar days.
- Which tier fixes the shortest property hold period? The Day-Use Locker, at one calendar day.

## Points of judgement
For every tier, the fixed disposal-eligible period runs longer than the fixed property-hold period (for example, the Small Locker tier holds property for fourteen calendar days but does not make it disposal-eligible until thirty calendar days), so the hold period and the disposal-eligible period are two distinct fixed figures rather than one figure counted twice.
